prompt:
Subject: Population statistics on a research desk.

Composition: Show a researcher arranging small age-varied human counters into adjacent transparent counting trays and consulting one simple age-distribution chart. The differing tray counts correspond to unlabelled bars, keeping the demographic grouping factual and equal in dignity without rankings or invented real-population figures.

Style: Use the attached invidious.png for drawing style only. Match its thick rounded dark-brown contours, simplified rounded shapes, and restrained 2D cartoon shading. Do not copy the reference subject or composition.

Framing: One compact composition, with the complete subject using about 80-90% of the square. Keep all limbs and object tips inside the frame.

Output: 512x512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background and transparent gaps. No text, speech balloons, explanatory captions, numerals, labels, logos or watermark.
en: A researcher groups age-varied human counters into trays and checks a matching unlabeled age-distribution chart.
ja: 研究者が年齢の異なる人物駒をトレイに分類し、対応する無記名の年齢分布図を確認する。
